description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions used in the CLI program, specifically testing functions like collectOption, parsePositiveIntOrUndefined, and resolveActionArgs, using the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: collectOption
methods.description: Collects and appends values to an array, used for command-line option aggregation.

methods.name: parsePositiveIntOrUndefined
methods.description: Parses a value into a positive integer or returns undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolveActionArgs
methods.description: Resolves the arguments from a command object or returns an empty array if invalid.
